options.name: Standard Monitoring — Whirligig
options.description: Start here for wallet activity, account changes and transaction updates. Uses your Triton RPC credential. You do not need a separate streaming server.

options.name: Live Blockchain Feed — Dragon’s Mouth
options.description: For custom real-time account and transaction feeds. Choose this when standard monitoring does not give you the data you need. Requires a Triton gRPC endpoint and stream token.

options.name: Low-Latency Live Feed — Riptide
options.description: Uses Dragon’s Mouth filters on a lower-latency mainnet connection. The shared riptide.rpcpool.com endpoint requires a shared gRPC subscription token; dedicated-node tokens require a separately arranged endpoint.

options.name: Readable App Activity — Vixen
options.description: Turns supported programs’ activity into parsed fields instead of raw bytes. Useful for monitoring apps such as Raydium or Orca. Requires a Vixen-enabled stream endpoint; a program-wide feed may be busy.

options.name: Live Swap Prices — Titan
options.description: Get changing quotes for swapping one token into another. This trigger only returns quotes; it does not buy or sell. Requires mainnet Titan access through your Triton RPC credential.

options.name: Early Transaction Feed — Deshred
options.description: For specialists who need reconstructed transactions before execution. An event is not proof of success or confirmation. Requires a Deshred-enabled stream endpoint.

options.name: Early Execution Signals — Harmonic
options.description: For advanced monitoring of provisional execution signals from one region. Results can change; confirm them later. Requires a Harmonic-enabled endpoint.

options.name: Early Bundle Signals — BAM
options.description: For advanced monitoring of bundle and transaction signals from one region. Outcomes may be absent and are not final. Requires a BAM-enabled endpoint.
